description: The Global Configuration keys the Integration Sidecar reads (architecture §2.3, implementation §1.2.5).

embedding_model.description: The network's vector space: the egress_registry entry the Embedding Model is reached through, the model requested from it and its prefix convention. It has no default: the network is born without a vector space (architecture §2.3, implementation §1.2.15).

entry.description: The egress_registry key of the Embedding Model.

model.description: The model requested from the entry.

document_prefix.description: The prefix of the capability_text side; empty in a model without prefixes.

query_prefix.description: The prefix of the task's text, the querying side (architecture §3.7.4); empty in a model without prefixes.

preconditions.message: the network opens only with embedding_model assigned (architecture §2.3, §3.18)
